mapper.select: SELECT a.`id` `id`, a.`subscribe_person` `subscribePerson`, a.`time_interval` `timeInterval`, a.`book_num` `bookNum`, a.`participant_type`, a.`participant_ids`, a.`content`, a.`STATUS`, a.`conference_theme` `conferenceTheme`, a.`goods_Names`, a.`cancel_reason`, b.`id` `conferenceId`, b.`name` `conferenceName`, b.`area_name` `areaName`, ct.`name` `conferenceType` FROM `book_room` a LEFT JOIN `conference` b ON a.`conference_id` = b.`id` LEFT JOIN `conference_type` ct on a.`conference_type` = ct.`id` where a.`id` = #{bookId}

SELECT DISTINCT a.`id` `id`, a.`time_interval` `timeInterval`, a.`status` `status`, c.`name` `conferenceName`, c.`id` `conferenceId`, c.`area_name` `areaName`, b.`appointment_date` `appointmentDate`
FROM `book_room` a LEFT JOIN `book_interval_record` b ON a.`id` = b.`book_id` LEFT JOIN `conference` c ON a.`conference_id` = c.`id` where a.`subscribe_person` = #{userId} order by a.`create_time` DESC
